text:
harper: anyone up for a VR demo + steam wishlist swap this Thu evening? got Quest 2 + a couple of indie demos, and a list of weird impulse buys from the sale :vr:

ryan: ooh yes. ill crash it with my Index controllers and a backlog of co-op games. what time are we thinking?

harper: thinking 7pm in the lounge. quick rotations — 20 min demo slots + chill time. also open to streaming a POV to the big screen for spectators.

tess: im down. can bring my VR hand controllers charger and spare face covers. also proposing a tiny steam-wishlist exchange: bring 3 wishlist items, swap numbers, buy each other something cheap? :money_with_wings: 

leo: sold for the wishlist swap. suggest a $5-10 cap so we don't go crazy.

jamie: can we also do a "show me the weirdest thing on your wishlist" mini-award? trophy = old conference sticker :tada: 

ryan: also put me down for a Rocket League local 2v2 if we have spare controllers after VR.

harper: agenda: 7:00 arrival + setup, 7:15 demo rotations start, 8:45 quick Rocket League bracket, 9:30 wishlist swap gift reveal, 10:00 wind down.

calendar-bot: Event created by harper: "VR Demos + Steam Wishlist Swap" Thu 7:00pm - 10:30pm (Lounge). RSVP: https://calendar.example.com/event/vr-steam-swap

tess: labeling volunteers: @ryan to projector hookup, @leo to music and speaker, @jamie to keep timer.

leo: ill try to bring a dongle kit (USB-C/DisplayPort/HDMI) and a short ethernet cable in case streaming is choppy.

harper: anyone allergic to latex? got a few silicone covers but want to avoid surprise sneezes.

jamie: no allergies here. ill print a tiny sign-up sheet for demo slots.

ryan: heads up: Steam sale has a weird bundle I want to show — could ruin productivity for everyone :grimacing: link: https://store.steampowered.example/sale

tess: perfect. ill bring small stickers for the trophy and a cheap bag for the swap gifts.

harper: cool. posting a quick RSVP + what youre bringing in #random so we don't duplicate chargers. see you thursday :vr_headset:
